hero.title: Building focused companies for long-term strategic growth.
hero.text: Paradigm Shift Ventures is a holding company that develops, owns, and supports operating businesses in sectors where resources, infrastructure, energy, and technology shape the future economy.

identity.title: A disciplined platform for operating subsidiaries

about.title: A holding company structured for resilient multi-sector expansion.
about.text:
Paradigm Shift Ventures provides a parent-company platform for focused operating businesses. The company is built to identify strategic opportunities, organize specialized subsidiaries, and support them with a clear institutional identity.

Its current portfolio includes Mineral Resources Development, with room to expand into aligned ventures across infrastructure, industrial systems, energy, and advanced technologies.

vision.title: From legacy systems to new paradigms.
vision.text: The company is designed around disciplined ownership, patient development, and a belief that strong operating platforms can shift markets when they are built with clarity and long-term intent.

subsidiaries.name: Mineral Resources Development
subsidiaries.description: Strategic extraction, processing, and industrial resource development for long-term mineral and material supply chains.
